title: Pasting the proper and open scalar/projection squares
statement: Fix coefficient systems $R,S$ and a coefficient change $a:R\to S$ as in [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Let $f:X\to Y$ have a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{r}Y$ and choose normalized tensor models on $X,Z,Y$ for both systems, with the canonical pullback compositors. For arbitrary derived objects $K,L$, assume the separate proper and open scalar/projection equations `ProjectionFactorIdentities` of [lem-sf-projection-factor-coordinates]. Then the compactification projection commutes with scalar change: $\rho_Y(\operatorname{PF}_R)\,c_f(H)\,Rf_{!,S}(a^f)=s_Y(c_f(K)\otimes1)\operatorname{PF}_S$, in composition order from left to right, where $H=K\otimes^LLf_R^*L$, $a^f$ is scalar/tensor followed by scalar/pullback comparison, and $c_f$ is the canonical proper/open scalar mate. All maps are those specified in the attached Lean declaration. Here the hypothesis consists of the proper equation $\rho(\pi_R)c_{M\otimes Lr_R^*L}Rr_{*,S}(a^r)=s_Y(c_M\otimes1)\pi_S(\rho M,\rho L)$ and the open equation $\rho(\gamma_R)d_Hj_{!,S}(a^f)=a^r(d_K\otimes1)\gamma_S(\rho K,\rho L)$, where $M=j_{!,R}K$, $c$ is the proper scalar mate, $d$ the open scalar mate, $\pi$ the proper counit projection and $\gamma$ the open tensor factor. The compactification maps are $\operatorname{PF}_T=\pi_T Rr_{*,T}(\gamma_T)$ for $T=R,S$.

proof.text:
expand the compactification projection and coefficient comparison. Apply
naturality of the proper coefficient map, then the open square, then the proper
square. Naturality of the reduced proper projection recombines the first input.

lean.statement:
theorem projection_scalar_square
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (hR : R.pull (c.i ≫ c.g) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i c.g
      (R.ring Y) (R.ring c.Z) (R.ring X) (R.pull c.g) (R.pull c.i))
    (hS : S.pull (c.i ≫ c.g) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i c.g
      (S.ring Y) (S.ring c.Z) (S.ring X) (S.pull c.g) (S.pull c.i))
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (R.ring X))
    (aZ : ProEtaleTensorModel c.Z (R.ring c.Z))
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (R.ring Y))
    (bX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (S.ring X))
    (bZ : ProEtaleTensorModel c.Z (S.ring c.Z))
    (bY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (S.ring Y))
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (R.ring X)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y (R.ring Y)))
    (hi : ProjectionFactorIdentities a c hR hS aX aZ aY bX bZ bY K L) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).map
        (((projectionMap R c aX aZ aY hR).app K).app L) ≫
      (comparison a c).app (aX.tensor.obj (K, (pull R f).obj L)) ≫
      (image S c).map (mixedChange a f aX bX K L) =
    (scalarTensor (a.map Y) aY bY).hom.app ((image R c).obj K, L) ≫
      bY.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((comparison a c).app K) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      ((projectionMap S c bX bZ bY hS).app
        ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map X)).obj K)).app
        ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).obj L)
